## Summary
Ashish Pal is a Cloud & DevOps Engineer and Junior Consultant at Xebia, based in Jaipur, Rajasthan, India. He holds a Master of Computer Applications (MCA) from Birla Institute of Technology, Mesra (BIT Mesra, CGPA 9.00) and a Bachelor of Computer Applications (BCA) from Manipal University Jaipur (CGPA 9.43). 

Ashish specializes in building scalable multi-subscription cloud infrastructure using Terraform, automating enterprise deployment pipelines (GitLab CI/CD, GitHub Actions, Atlantis, Ansible), and developing cutting-edge Generative AI agents (CrewAI, LangChain, Google Calendar AI Assistant, Vision Voice Agents).

Interests: Cloud Architecture, Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD Automation, Generative AI & Multi-Agent Systems, Data Science & Machine Learning.

## Portfolio Website Architecture
This portfolio is built as a single-page application (SPA) featuring:
- **Interactive Web Shell Terminal**: Embedded terminal emulator linking to `https://ashrokss.github.io/` with bash commands, profile stats, and matrix visualizer.
- **Ashish AI Chat Assistant**: Interactive AI assistant widget trained on Ashish's bio, skills, and background.
- **Neo-Brutalist Theme ("Brutal Mode")**: High-contrast yellow theme toggle with thick borders, sharp drop shadows, and Space Grotesk typography.
- **Responsive Resume Viewer**: Dual-view PDF renderer supporting both desktop iframe viewing and mobile canvas rendering.
